system.description:
Favoured weapon: Trident

Granted power: Advantage on Swim and water-based checks. Once/day, when your Smite hits, a wave breaks over the target and a 15ft line behind it: each creature there makes a Fortitude save or is pushed 15ft and knocked Prone.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Umberlee in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: pay the sea a tithe from every prize you take (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
